an interprofessional training program, based on simulation, is effective to improve the skills for intrahospital patient transport.
an interprofessional simulation based model is feasible and effective in improving both technical and non technical skills in transport teams.

the development and assessment of an IIST model for transport teams of newly registered staff.
the training of interprofessional teams in the field of intrahospital transport.
a training program for intrapartum transport of critically ill newborns.
